# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Set working directory (adjust to your file location)
# setwd("path/to/your/data")

# ============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================

# Read the Matrix Market format file
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell identifiers)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes (feature identifiers)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_name")

# Assign row and column names to the matrix
rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_name
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                           project = "PBMC2700", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

cat("Seurat object created with", ncol(pbmc), "cells and", nrow(pbmc), "genes\n")

# ============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL (Optional but recommended)
# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics (adjust thresholds as needed)
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

cat("After QC filtering:", ncol(pbmc), "cells remaining\n")

# ============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================================

# Normalize the data using log-normalization
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, 
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
                      scale.factor = 10000)

cat("Data normalized\n")

# ============================================================================
# 4. IDENTIFY HIGHLY VARIABLE FEATURES
# ============================================================================

# Find the top 2000 highly variable genes
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, 
                             selection.method = "vst", 
                             nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Plot variable features
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(plot2)

# ============================================================================
# 5. SCALE THE DATA
# ============================================================================

# Scale all genes
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

cat("Data scaled\n")

# ============================================================================
# 6. PERFORM PCA
# ============================================================================

# Run PCA on the scaled data
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, 
               features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc), 
               npcs = 50)

# Visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)

# Elbow plot to determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# Visualize PCA
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# ============================================================================
# 7. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

# Find neighbors and clusters
# Using first 20 PCs (adjust based on elbow plot)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Find clusters with resolution 0.5 (adjust for granularity)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

cat("Number of clusters identified:", length(unique(Idents(pbmc))), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 8. RUN UMAP
# ============================================================================

# Compute UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

cat("UMAP computed\n")

# ============================================================================
# 9. VISUALIZE CLUSTERS
# ============================================================================

# UMAP plot colored by cluster
p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 6,
              pt.size = 1) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters (UMAP)")
print(p1)

# Save high-resolution plot
ggsave("pbmc_umap_clusters.png", plot = p1, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# UMAP plot with cluster labels
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 5,
              repel = TRUE,
              pt.size = 1) +
  NoLegend() +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters with Labels")
print(p2)

# ============================================================================
# 10. FIND CLUSTER MARKERS (Optional)
# ============================================================================

# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, 
                               only.pos = TRUE, 
                               min.pct = 0.25, 
                               logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Get top 5 markers per cluster
top5_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

print(top5_markers)

# Visualize top markers
top_genes <- top5_markers %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 2) %>% 
  pull(gene) %>% 
  unique()

FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = head(top_genes, 9), ncol = 3)

# Heatmap of top markers
DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top5_markers$gene) + 
  NoLegend() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

# ============================================================================
# 11. SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================================

# Save the Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_analysis.rds")

# Save cluster assignments
cluster_assignments <- data.frame(
  barcode = colnames(pbmc),
  cluster = Idents(pbmc)
)
write.csv(cluster_assignments, "cluster_assignments.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save marker genes
write.csv(pbmc.markers, "cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnalysis complete! Results saved.\n")
cat("Seurat object saved as: pbmc_analysis.rds\n")
cat("Cluster assignments saved as: cluster_assignments.csv\n")
cat("Marker genes saved as: cluster_markers.csv\n")

# ============================================================================
# 12. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total cells analyzed:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Total genes:", nrow(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Number of clusters:", length(unique(Idents(pbmc))), "\n")
cat("Cells per cluster:\n")
print(table(Idents(pbmc)))

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================================
# 1. Load the 10X-style data files
# ============================================================================

# Read the sparse matrix (Matrix Market format)
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell identifiers)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes (gene IDs and symbols)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_symbol")

# Assign row and column names to the matrix
rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

# ============================================================================
# 2. Create Seurat object
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = matrix,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,      # Keep genes expressed in at least 3 cells
  min.features = 200  # Keep cells with at least 200 genes
)

# ============================================================================
# 3. Quality Control (QC) filtering
# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

cat("Cells after QC filtering:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 4. Normalization
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# ============================================================================
# 5. Identify highly variable features
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 6. Scaling the data
# ============================================================================

all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# ============================================================================
# 7. Perform linear dimensional reduction (PCA)
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc), npcs = 50)

# Visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# Determine dimensionality of the dataset
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# ============================================================================
# 8. Clustering
# ============================================================================

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Find clusters
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

cat("Number of clusters:", length(unique(Idents(pbmc))), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 9. Run UMAP for visualization
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Visualize UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("PBMC 2700 - UMAP Clustering")

# ============================================================================
# 10. Find marker genes for every cluster
# ============================================================================

# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  pbmc, 
  only.pos = TRUE,           # Only positive markers
  min.pct = 0.25,            # Expressed in at least 25% of cells
  logfc.threshold = 0.25     # Log fold-change threshold
)

# View top markers
cat("\nTop markers per cluster:\n")
print(pbmc.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC))

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================

top5_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

  size = 3,
  angle = 90

  ggtitle("Top 5 Marker Genes per Cluster") +

# Save Seurat object

library(Matrix)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, rownames = genes[, 2], colnames = barcodes[, 1])

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
elbow <- which.max(pbmc@reductions$pca@jackstraw$p.values[, 2])
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)

# Cluster cells
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Define marker genes for each cell type
marker_genes <- list(
  "CD4 T cells" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD14 Monocytes" = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  "B cells" = c("MS4A1"),
  "CD8 T cells" = c("CD8A"),
  "NK cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Find markers for each cluster
cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Annotate clusters with cell type labels
cell_type_labels <- character(nrow(pbmc@meta.data))
for (i in 1:ncol(cluster_markers)) {
  cluster <- cluster_markers[[i]]
  for (cell_type in names(marker_genes)) {
    markers <- marker_genes[[cell_type]]
    if (any(cluster$gene %in% markers)) {
      cell_type_labels[pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters == i] <- cell_type
    }
  }
}

# Add cell type labels to Seurat object
pbmc@meta.data$cell_type <- cell_type_labels

# Visualize UMAP with cell type labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type")

# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
seurat_object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                                    project = "PBMCs", 
                                    genes = genes[, 2], 
                                    cells = barcodes[, 1])

# Normalize data
seurat_object <- NormalizeData(seurat_object, 
                               normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
                               scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
seurat_object <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_object, 
                                      selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
seurat_object <- ScaleData(seurat_object, 
                            features = VariableFeatures(seurat_object))

# Run PCA
seurat_object <- RunPCA(seurat_object, 
                         features = VariableFeatures(seurat_object))

# Determine significant PCs
seurat_object <- JackStraw(seurat_object, 
                          num.replicate = 100)

# Select significant PCs
seurat_object <- RunUMAP(seurat_object, 
                         dims = 1:10)

# Cluster cells
seurat_object <- FindNeighbors(seurat_object, 
                                dims = 1:10)
seurat_object <- FindClusters(seurat_object, 
                              resolution = 0.5)

# Perform differential expression analysis
cluster0 <- subset(seurat_object, idents = "0")
cluster3 <- subset(seurat_object, idents = "3")
diff_exp <- FindMarkers(cluster0, cluster3)

# Create volcano plot
volcano_data <- data.frame(log2FC = diff_exp$avg_logFC, 
                           p_val_adj = diff_exp$p_val_adj)
volcano_data$significant <- ifelse(abs(volcano_data$log2FC) > 1 & volcano_data$p_val_adj < 0.05, "yes", "no")

ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significant)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value")
